notes.1.10: nw is taken as 'measuring' (or 'time'), and ḏḏ.w as 'places'; the construction is uncertain.

nodes.text: [As for] the measuring when any wab-priest of Sekhmet or any physician places his hands or his fingers [on the head], [on the back of the head], on the hands, on the place of the heart, or on the feet, [he] measures [for] the heart.
As for 'entering from outside': it is the breath of an outside god, or of a dead person.
